name: Diagnosing and Replacing Sequencers
summary:
Diagnosing and Replacing Sequencers is an immersive VR training application developed as part of the Immerse Learn Diagnosing and Replacing Sequencers micro-credential program. This application provides learners with realistic, hands-on practice in identifying faulty sequencers, diagnosing HVAC system issues, performing replacement procedures, and understanding proper system operation in a simulated training environment.
